summary: Iteration 8 backend-only testing. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_cakmad_api.py with 17 new tests across 5 classes for extended predictions (scorer + MOTM). TestIter8MatchesShape (1): GET /api/matches items carry scorer_player_ids (list of str, defaults []) and motm_player_id (nullable str). TestIter8LiveMatchShape (1): GET /api/live-match returns {live:false} when not live; if live, embedded match has both new fields. TestIter8PredictAuthGate (4): POST /api/matches/{id}/predict with and without extended scorer_player_id/motm_player_id body — 401 missing_token w/o auth, 401 invalid_session with bogus bearer, 401 whether or not scorer/motm fields are present. TestIter8AdminResultAuthGate (4): POST /api/admin/matches/{id}/result accepts optional scorer_player_ids (list[str]) and motm_player_id (nullable str) — body is 401 missing_token/invalid_session without valid auth, including empty list + null motm_player_id variant to confirm validation passes before auth is checked. TestRegressionIter8 (7): /api/, /api/players, /api/predictions/leaderboard, /api/top-streaks, /api/weekly-theme, /api/leaderboard/weekly, /api/notifications (401). Final: 157/157 PASSED against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (previous 140 + 17 new). As per request, no valid Google session_id available — scoring semantics (exact=300, winner=100, scorer=+150, motm=+200) and notification side-effects were NOT exercised end-to-end; only shape + 401 boundaries + regression were covered.

minor.issue: No validation that scorer_player_ids members or motm_player_id reference existing players. Invalid player_ids are silently stored and the scorer_hit/motm_hit comparison will just miss. Consider validating against db.players (exists + not deleted + included_in_quiz) and 422 on unknown ids.

scorer_player_ids is a list — a player who scored a brace is counted only once. Prediction scoring only awards +150 if the predicted scorer appears at least once; this is fine, but admins may be confused by de-dup. Document semantics or dedupe server-side explicitly.
scorer_player_id/motm_player_id are not validated against the players collection. A user can submit any string and get the (null) scorer_name/motm_name. Validate and 422 on unknown player_id.
No restriction that scorer_player_id must be included_in_quiz (or in the actual squad). Minor product decision — flag if intended to restrict.

Scorer bonus awards +150 for ANY match (even losses). Confirm with product whether scorer bonus should require the predicted scorer to have actually scored, which is already covered — but there is no cap on how high the bonus can stack (exact 300 + winner implicit + scorer 150 + motm 200 = 650 max). Consider documenting the max in /api docs.

MatchOut always returns scorer_player_ids=[] for matches created before this iteration — older docs lacking the field get defaulted via _match_to_out (m.get('scorer_player_ids', []) or []). Correct behavior, just note data migration is not needed but older matches will display 'no scorer recorded' until an admin re-sets the result.

action_items: Add player_id validation on POST /api/admin/matches/{id}/result (scorer_player_ids members + motm_player_id must exist in db.players with deleted_at absent) → 422 on unknown.
Add player_id validation on POST /api/matches/{id}/predict (scorer_player_id + motm_player_id, when provided) → 422 on unknown.
Expose scoring rubric in GET /api/weekly-theme or a dedicated /api/predictions/rules endpoint so the mobile UI can render the point breakdown dynamically instead of hard-coding (300/100/150/200).
Return scorer_name / motm_name in MatchOut (list[str] of scorer names + motm name) so clients don't need to cross-reference /api/players — currently only the predictions list exposes names.
Carried over from iter 7: add Pydantic Field(ge=0, le=99) on pred_home/pred_away and final_home/final_away; clamp predictions_leaderboard limit (ge=1, le=200).
Carried over: split server.py (now >1270 lines) into routers (matches/predictions is the biggest sub-domain now).
Carried over: narrow CORS allow_origins in prod; $unset champion_until on expiry; $setOnInsert prediction_id/created_at on upsert; bulk_write prediction scoring loop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1035-1046: scoring loop runs find({match_id, points NOT EXISTS}) then per-doc update_one. For a popular match with 1k predictions this is 1k round-trips. Switch to bulk_write with UpdateOne operations and gather the notifications into asyncio.gather at the end.
server.py line 1037: `if p.get('scorer_player_id') and p['scorer_player_id'] in scorer_ids` — scorer_ids is a list, O(n) lookup per prediction. Convert to set() once outside the async-for loop.

server.py line 1086-1093: scorer_name/motm_name lookup does one find_one per prediction create — fine today, but if a user edits their prediction repeatedly it's two round-trips every time. Cheap optimization: single aggregated $in lookup after validation.
server.py line 1015: scorer_ids = list(body.scorer_player_ids or []) — Pydantic default_factory=list already guarantees a list, so the `or []` is redundant. Minor.

server.py line 1058: notification message interpolates m['opponent'] which was fetched BEFORE the result update. Fine for opponent, but if admin edits opponent concurrently it may show stale data. Fetch again after update or pass opponent explicitly.

Scoring is non-idempotent-safe: re-running the SAME /result call does not re-score (filter points NOT EXISTS). Good. But editing the result (different final_home/away) does NOT re-score existing predictions. Admins who correct a score will have stale points. Document or add a 'force_rescore=true' query.
Carried over: StreakLeader still exposes username (friend-code) publicly; predictions_leaderboard pipeline has no tie-breaker; no GET /api/matches/{id} single-fetch endpoint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To fully verify Iteration 8 end-to-end a valid Google session_id is required. Required flows: (1) auth as admin + 3 users. (2) Seed players (POST /api/admin/seed-players) and capture 3 player_ids p1, p2, p3. (3) POST /api/admin/matches with kickoff_at in future. (4) Each user POSTs /api/matches/{id}/predict with various combos: user1={pred_home:2,pred_away:1,scorer_player_id:p1,motm_player_id:p2} (exact+scorer+motm), user2={pred_home:3,pred_away:1,scorer_player_id:p3,motm_player_id:p1} (winner-only), user3={pred_home:0,pred_away:2,scorer_player_id:None,motm_player_id:None} (wrong winner, no bonuses). (5) GET /api/me/prediction/{id} returns each user's own prediction with scorer_name/motm_name populated from the players collection. (6) POST /api/admin/matches/{id}/result {final_home:2,final_away:1,scorer_player_ids:[p1,p3],motm_player_id:p2} → verify DB: user1 points = 300+150+200 = 650; user2 points = 100+150+0 = 250 (p3 scored, p1 not MOTM); user3 points = 0. (7) GET /api/predictions/leaderboard reflects the totals. (8) GET /api/matches response items include the stored scorer_player_ids list and motm_player_id. (9) Verify notifications pushed with 'tepat skor +300 · pencetak gol +150 · MOTM +200' message parts matching the earned bonuses. Known minor issues: no player_id validation on either /result or /predict, no re-score on edited result, scorer list dedup unclear — flagged for product decision.
